description:
List VPCs for a project. Returns each VPC's ID, cloud, state, and network CIDR.

Use this when the user explicitly asks to deploy an application into a VPC. List them, show the user the options, and let them pick which VPC to deploy into.

VPCs with state `ACTIVE` are ready to use. Pass the chosen `project_vpc_id` to `aiven_application_create`. If the user did not request VPC, do not call this tool for application creation — `aiven_application_create` sends `project_vpc_id: null` by default.

This tool returns a list of VPCs with the following fields:
- project_vpc_id: The ID of the VPC
- cloud_name: The cloud region identifier where the VPC runs (e.g. `aws-eu-central-2`, `google-europe-north2`)
- state: The state of the VPC (e.g. `ACTIVE`, `APPROVED`)
- network_cidr: The network CIDR of the VPC
name: aiven_project_vpc_list
title: Project Vpc List
